item.text: {"analysis":"The host run succeeded after removing learned item biases. Training and both candidate-scoring branches use only dot products between encoded states and the shared item embeddings, satisfying the host scoring requirement. Validation HR@10 was 0.645, with NDCG@10 of 0.416974. The best checkpoint occurred at epoch 10 of 30 completed epochs. No comparison result is provided, so ranking improvement cannot be attributed to bias removal.","code_summary":"Causal NextItNet with maximum sequence length 128, 64-dimensional shared item embeddings, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block gates between local and dilated kernel-3 convolutions, then applies a second dilated convolution, with LayerNorm, GELU, dropout 0.2, and learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1. Padding is masked after each block; candidate scoring uses the last nonpadding state. LR=0.001, weight decay=0, batch size=128. Existing interfaces are preserved."}
